description: This file defines a feature component for listing tags in an ASP.NET Core application. It includes a request class, a request handler that fetches tags from the database context, and constructs an envelope with the list of tag identifiers.

classes.name: List.Query
classes.description: The request object implementing IRequest, expecting a TagsEnvelope response.

classes.name: List.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the query by querying the database context for tags and returning a tags envelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves tags ordered by TagId, converts them into a list of strings, and wraps them in a TagsEnvelope.
